pages.title: How this book works
pages.body: Read a short coaching note, then play on the on-screen keyboard. Use Play phrase to hear the pattern. Progress stays in this browser.

pages.title: Hand position
pages.body: Curve the fingers as if holding a small ripe plum. Wrists level. Shoulders quiet. We outline C-E-G before scales.

pages.title: Soft curved hand
pages.prompt: Tap C-E-G as a gentle chord outline.

pages.title: Five-finger pattern
pages.body: Thumb on C. Each finger owns one white key. Ascend C D E F G, then descend. Keep the pulse even — accuracy before speed.

pages.title: C major five-finger
pages.prompt: Play ascending, then descending. Keep a steady pulse.

pages.title: A familiar motif
pages.body: Twinkle Twinkle is public domain. We use only the opening motif so the drill stays short and memorable.

pages.title: Twinkle motif (public domain)
pages.prompt: Hum once, then play. Match the rhythm you heard.

pages.title: Name the five-finger keys
pages.q: Starting on C, list the five white keys in order (letters).
pages.placeholder: e.g. C D E F G

pages.title: Lesson parked
pages.body: Nice work. Return to the hub for Call check-in, or reopen Piano anytime.
